title: Concept: Anchor navigates to a data: URI
description: A data: URI in an anchor turns a link into an inline document whose origin rules differ per engine, and it moves the payload out of any server-side destination log. It is the standard way to smuggle a script link past a review that only checks the href host.
risk: Clicking the link opens a document assembled from the page itself, which can display a forged form or run script depending on the engine, and leaves no external host to inspect.
